meta.title: Branch point
meta.description:
**After CopyReserved, two mutually exclusive continuations follow** (a decision point, not two separate stories):
- Branch A (cols 6-9): member picks up the copy → BookCheckedOut / CopyCheckedOut → later BookReturned / CopyReturned.
- Branch B (cols 10-11): the reservation lapses or is cancelled instead → ReservationReleased / CopyReservationReleased.

Both branches are shown left-to-right (A fully, then B) rather than as a forking diagram, since the board's columns are linear — the actual branching is captured in Step 7 scenarios.
